answer: We define a dynamic opportunity-cost bond mechanism where staking collateral grows as a convex function of identity density, effectively sequestering capital on an isolated island of protocol utility. By deploying a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, we treat malicious actor proliferation as a geological karst formation, wherein sub-optimal nodes collapse into a relic state under severe slashing penalties. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay primitives ensure that multiplying identities yields negative utility, forcing Nash equilibrium convergence.
